description: What conditions is this drug used for? Lists the conditions a drug is recorded as able to treat (may_treat) in the US Veterans Health Administration MED-RT reference, via the U.S. National Library of Medicine RxClass (e.g. metformin: Diabetes Mellitus, Type 2), with MeSH condition IDs. Useful for students, carers and agents wanting a short structured list rather than label prose. MED-RT is a reference terminology, not a full or current list of licensed indications, and off-label uses are not covered; not medical advice. (cost: 1 credit)

name.description: string, required, a generic or brand drug name (e.g. "metformin")
